A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Let’s make
planning easy.

Every family is different. Get the details you need before choosing your session.

How do I enquire about a session?

Choose a session idea below and send your preferred date on WhatsApp. The studio can discuss availability and confirm the details with you.

What are the packages and prices?

Ask the studio for a quote based on your session, the number of people, and the photographs or prints you would like. Confirm inclusions and pricing before booking.

Can we bring our own outfits and ideas?

Share your outfit, theme, or reference ideas when you enquire. Check with the studio about outfit changes, props, and what to bring.

When will we receive our photographs?

Ask the studio to confirm the editing and delivery timeline, the number of selected photographs, and the delivery format when you book.
